details.label: Today's Hazards
details.text: This afternoon and tonight. Showers and thunderstorms are possible into the overnight hours. Some storms could be severe with damaging winds, large hail, and heavy downpours possible.

details.label: Extended Outlook
details.text: Wednesday through Monday. Showers and thunderstorms are expected on Wednesday and Thursday, Some storms could be severe on both days. Mainly during the afternoon/evening but there is a potential for some overnight storms as well. Main threat is damaging winds and large hail with the possibility of a tornado.
